name: datenriff
description: Vertical Atlas Germany — interactive data sculptures of Germany (Datenriff)

scripts.build: npm run build:pages && npm run build -w @datenriff/web && node scripts/copy-legal.mjs
scripts.build:packages: tsc -p packages/data-contracts && tsc -p packages/color-scales && tsc -p packages/sculpture-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @datenriff/web
scripts.test:packages: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/color-scales/test/*.test.mjs packages/sculpture-core/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:pipeline
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/prune-dist.mjs && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name datenriff
